notes.title: Version 1.0.3 - A few more adjustments
notes.content:
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Made a small change for Wind Shrine so that defeating the area boss would be more rewarding.
[*] Changed map button colors to be more understandable.
[*] Decreased movement speed of shark enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - More small fixes and adjustments
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the deadzone of gamepad stick inputs.
[*] Fixed a problem where inventory inputs were being taken twice back to back.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Sunken Temple trap rooms to be less bullshit. (whops, sorry about that)
[*] Changed Sunken Temple map to show underwater room entrances.
[*] Made small adjustments to a few enemy trap room encounters.
[*] Made a certain Wind Shrine enemy easier to parry.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Small fixes and adjustments
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where game didn't allow the window resolution to be changed in some monitors. (I'm hoping this is fixed but if there's still a problem please let me know!)
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed piranha enemies to be less aggressive.
[*] Changed archer enemies to be less aggressive in melee range.
[*] Changed an enemy trap encounter in Sunken Temple to be more forgiving.
[*] Shortened an enemy trap encounter in Wind Shrine.
[/list]
